title: IVS Remediation
purpose: Clients have been paying for insurance verification they were not receiving, for about two years, because of implementation error. Fix it in waves without force-placing residents or overloading the team.

tiles.label: Clients affected
tiles.sub: from the client and policy sheet

tiles.label: Policies unverified
tiles.sub: liability exposure if a loss occurs

items.text: Review the client and policy data and summarize clients affected and policies unverified on this page.
Verify policies. If an unverified policy has a loss, Entrata could be liable for it.
Write the wave plan: which clients are turned on when, so clients are told first, no resident is force-placed, and the team can absorb the load.
Keep tracking issues under 30 days old separately from the backlog.

sections.title: Why not a mass rollout
sections.body: Clients would notice, residents could be force-placed, and the internal team cannot absorb the workload all at once. Credits and client outreach come first; settings are corrected in waves.
